offering_description.value: Provides investment management funds and separate accounts across money market, equity, fixed income and alternative strategies. Serves institutional clients, financial advisors and individual investors, earning fees on assets it manages and services.

primary_products.value: money market funds; equity funds; fixed income funds; alternative investment funds; separate accounts

primary_services.value: investment management; shareholder and administrative services; institutional advisory services

customer_segment.value: B2B: institutional investors, corporations, banks, insurers and retirement plan sponsors; B2C: individual retail investors, often through financial advisors

end_markets.value: asset management; retirement and savings; banking and insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: investment management fees charged as a percentage of assets managed in funds and accounts; service fees: shareholder servicing and administration fees paid by funds
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools client capital into funds and accounts and invests it, sold to institutions and individual investors; service provider: provides fund administration and shareholder servicing to fund investors

geography_served.value: global: clients in the United States and internationally, with offices in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: money market, equity, fixed income and alternative investment strategies sharing investors, advisors and distribution channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: institutional sales teams selling to corporate and public plan clients; agents / brokers: broker-dealers and financial advisors that place fund shares for their clients; online: direct-to-investor website and online account access

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and broker-dealer activities regulated by the SEC and FINRA, plus foreign financial regulators
